cycles.problem: No explicit expert mode; direct tools are difficult to discover.
cycles.problem_zh: 专家模式没有明确入口，直接工具难以发现。
cycles.improvement: Persistent compact Expert/Guided selector and expert tools hub; actual mode-switch and cancellation tests.
cycles.improvement_zh: 紧凑且持续可见的专家/引导选择与专家工具入口；实测切换与取消。

cycles.problem: Re is display-only and reference length is implicit.
cycles.problem_zh: Re 只能显示，参考长度含义不明确。
cycles.improvement: SI Re calculator, geometric/custom L and U/nu solve; 66 combinations and 1–10^7 endpoints; consistent force/FFT reference.
cycles.improvement_zh: SI Re 计算器、几何/自定义 L、U/nu 联动；66 组及 1–10^7 端点测试；力系数与 FFT 参考统一。

cycles.problem: Re alone cannot certify a model or mesh; generic recommendations would be misleading.
cycles.problem_zh: 仅凭 Re 无法认证模型或网格，泛化推荐容易误导。
cycles.improvement: Goal-specific, cylinder-scoped heuristic advice; 3D/span/wall/Mach limitations and primary sources.
cycles.improvement_zh: 按目标和圆柱适用范围给出启发建议，说明三维/展向/近壁/Ma 限制并提供原始来源。

cycles.problem: Dictionary overrides can supersede GUI values; older mesh evidence can be stale.
cycles.problem_zh: 字典覆盖可能替代界面参数；旧网格证据可能失配。
cycles.improvement: Explicit U/nu override review/reset, design and case-metadata matching, gated model-only application.
cycles.improvement_zh: 明确核对/重置 U/nu 覆盖，匹配设计与算例元数据，受控地只应用模型。

cycles.problem: Real cold build failed on Windows CRLF; repeat mesh measurement was slow; bad metrics and narrow layouts need guarding.
cycles.problem_zh: 真实首次编译因 Windows CRLF 失败；重复网格测量耗时，非法指标与窄布局需保护。
cycles.improvement: Force LF Make/files; genuine cold compile/MPI retest; mesh SHA-256 cache with threshold checks; finite/Mach/stale guards; native bilingual visual QA and full-pipeline regression.
cycles.improvement_zh: Make/files 强制 LF，真实首次编译/MPI 复测；网格 SHA-256/阈值缓存；有限值/Ma/失配检查；原生中英视觉及全流程回归。

scope: Five sequential review stages with corrections; final integration and retained failures are separate from passing targeted checks.
additional_long_test_fix: Standalone Viewer canonical field/slice data initialized in constructor; unknown/empty slice safely displays full volume. Original Round1 postprocessing failure retained in eight_long_runs ledger; genuine completed fields reopened and retested.
